title: Device End-of-Life Decision Workflow
description: Route a retiring laptop to donation or to responsible disposal, and see how one club's retirement becomes another's intake.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: Network, Peripherals, and the Device Lifecycle

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given a retiring laptop's condition, the learner differentiates whether it should be routed to a donation program or to the club's end-of-life plan.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Hover-to-preview and click-to-pin decision flow with two gates and a link back into another club's supply
pedagogical.assessment: Give a working but five-year-old laptop and ask which path it takes and what must happen first.
